name: YTFetch
description: Use Gemini API to directly read public YouTube URLs and return multimodal video/audio analysis without downloading the video locally.
author: VCP Community

invocationCommands.description: Fetch and analyze a public YouTube video through Gemini direct YouTube URL input. Parameters: url(required), prompt(optional), model(optional, default gemini-2.5-flash-lite), fallbackModels(optional comma-separated), maxOutputTokens(optional, default 40000), thinkingBudget(optional), raw(optional boolean). command=list_models lists available non-Pro generateContent models.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:<YTFetch>
url:<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BClcpTpEyn4>
prompt:<Use Simplified Chinese. Summarize the video content, visuals, audio, and key timeline.>
model:<gemini-2.5-flash-lite>
maxOutputTokens:<40000>
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
